text:
olivia: tiny sync re: prefetch defaults for SDKs (py/ts/go). server vs client ownership? tradeoffs.
mike: note: today both sides sometimes prefetch -> duplicated load.
sara: hosted should be server-owned by default. single place to tune, easier telemetry + throttles. SDKs can opt-out.
raj: private/dedicated customers will prefer client-local defaults. server default would surprise them.
olivia: middle ground: keep same SDK surface; mode=auto resolves to server in hosted, client in private/dedicated. makes operator experience consistent.
casey: API suggestion (uniform across languages):
```
client = RedwoodClient({prefetch:{mode:"auto",window_tokens:128}})
```
mike: two open questions: (1) who handles prefetch backoff/retry? (2) how do we avoid double-prefetch when an old SDK talks to a new server?
sara: (1) whoever performs the prefetch handles backoff; server side uses server rate limiter. SDKs must implement cancel/resume idempotently. (2) server should advertise capability via header `x-rw-prefetch: handled=v1` so SDKs detect and skip local prefetch. lightweight versioned handshake.
raj: transport nuance: prefer unary header handshake default; expose optional control stream on long-lived sessions for active adjustments. streaming works well for low-latency but is heavier for smaller SDKs.
olivia: proposal: unary header + opt-in Session API that opens a control stream for `prefetch_adjust` events.
casey: example: python: `session = client.open_session(prefetch_stream=True)`; ts: `const s = client.session({prefetchStream:true})` -> stream events.
mike: billing: speculative prefetch may consume tokens then error. we should bill only used tokens; track `prefetch_speculative` telemetry flag to attribute waste. default conservative window (128).
sara: agreed; add telemetry labels: `prefetch_mode`, `prefetch_speculative`, `server_prefetch_version`.
raj: long-term refactor: merge prefetch + kv-cache into single client-side cache/policy module so swapping strategies is easy. add to Q3 roadmap.
olivia: decision summary: hosted -> server-owned default; private/dedicated -> client default; SDKs expose `prefetch.mode` with `auto|server|client|off`; server advertises `x-rw-prefetch` header; unary headers by default, optional control stream via Session API; conservative default window_tokens=128; telemetry + e2e tests for fallbacks.
casey: i'll draft a small RFC PR with wire names, header docs, migration notes.
mike: i'll add e2e test matrix (old-sdk + new-server, server-prefetch stress tests).
deploy-bot: created issue INFR-2237: "prefetch ownership + sdk handshake" assigned to @casey.
olivia: tagging followups: @sara spec telemetry, @raj proto for session stream, @mike create tests.
sara: will spec telemetry fields and billing attribution.
raj: proto draft in ~3h, pinging for review.
casey: RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/703 (WIP).
olivia: thanks all. closing thread; reopen if needed. :rocket:
